text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond conquered the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She vowed to challenge every summit as a 
"legendary Umamusume" and contribute to 
the development of the Japanese Umamusume 
world from now on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that future will continue to be walked 
together with Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if their paths may differ, both will 
keep looking forward. They promised to 
keep running side by side together.
